name: MyTop Notification Bar
author: Jumedeen khan

sections.description:
MyTop Notification Bar is a best WordPress notification bar plugin for displaying announcements, offers, notices, and countdown timers at the top of your website.

Create and customize your notification bar directly from the WordPress dashboard and control where, when, and to whom it appears. No coding is required.

Key Features

  • Notification Bar – Display a notification bar at the top or bottom of your website.
  • Call to Action – Add a text link, filled button, or outline button.
  • Sticky Bar – Keep the bar visible while visitors scroll.
  • Countdown Timer – Display a customizable countdown to a specific date and time.
  • Scheduling – Set start and end dates for automatic display.
  • Display Rules – Show the bar sitewide, on the homepage, or on specific pages and posts.
  • User Visibility – Target guests, logged-in users, or specific user roles.
  • Dismissible Bar – Allow visitors to close the bar permanently or temporarily.
  • Auto Close – Automatically close the bar after a specified time.
  • Scroll Trigger – Display the bar after visitors scroll down the page.
  • Entrance Animations – Choose from fade, slide, and drop effects.
  • Mobile Visibility – Hide the bar on smaller screens.
  • Design Customization – Choose ready-made themes or customize the bar’s appearance.
  • Custom ID and Class – Apply your own CSS styling.
  • Import & Export – Easily back up and transfer plugin settings.
  • Shortcode & Block – Display the bar within posts and pages using the [mytop_bar] shortcode or the Notification Bar block.

What Can You Create with MyTop Bar?

My Top Notification Bar is ideal for displaying important messages, promoting offers, boosting conversions, and keeping your visitors informed.

  • Website announcements and important notices.
  • Promotional banners and discount offers.
  • Sale countdowns and limited-time deals.
  • Free shipping notifications.
  • Product launches and upcoming events.
  • Welcome messages and seasonal greetings.

Third-Party Libraries

MyTop Bar uses lightweight CSS and vanilla JavaScript on the frontend, with a script size of less than 5 KB. It does not depend on jQuery or any third-party libraries.

External Services

MyTop is fully self-contained and does not rely on external services or make external requests of its own. All plugin settings are stored locally in the WordPress database.

A functional cookie is used to remember when a visitor dismisses the notification bar. No personal data is collected or used for tracking.

Documentation & Support

Official Website | Documentation | Support | Contact Us
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “MyTop Notification Bar”.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Open the Notification Bar settings screen.
  5. Configure your message, customize the bar, and enable it.

Alternatively, upload the plugin ZIP file through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
sections.faq:
Where do I configure the notification bar?

After activation, open MyTop Bar from your WordPress admin menu to configure and enable the bar.

Does MyTop work with any WordPress theme?

MyTop uses the standard WordPress wp_body_open and wp_footer hooks, making it compatible with themes that properly implement these hooks.

Can I display the bar only on specific pages?

Yes. Choose “Specific pages & posts” under the display settings and enter the page IDs separated by commas.

Can I schedule the notification bar?

Yes. Set the start and end dates to automatically control when the notification bar appears and disappears.

Can I add a countdown timer to my notification bar?

Yes. Enable the countdown timer, set an end date and time, and customize its appearance. It is ideal for limited-time offers, flash sales, product launches, and upcoming events.

Can I display the bar inside a post or page?

Yes. Use the [mytop_bar] shortcode or insert the Notification Bar block in the WordPress block editor.

The inline bar uses the same message, button, and countdown settings without the close button, scroll trigger, auto-close, or reopen functionality.

Place the shortcode on its own line or inside a Shortcode block rather than within a sentence.

Will MyTop slow down my website?

MyTop is designed to minimize performance overhead by using lightweight frontend assets without external library dependencies.

Why is my notification bar not showing?

Make sure the bar is enabled and that the display rules, user visibility, schedule, and mobile settings allow it to appear on the current page.

Clear your website cache if necessary.

Does the plugin collect or share any user data?

No. MyTop does not track visitors, collect personal data for its own purposes, or send information to external services.

Are my settings deleted when I uninstall the plugin?

By default, your settings are retained. Enable “Delete data on uninstall” in the plugin settings to remove them when the plugin is deleted.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Settings saved notice behavior improved.
  • Green check for success, red icon and color for errors.
  • Settings screen colors now come from –mytop-bar-* tokens.
  • Fixed settings notice colors in dark mode.
  • Dark mode now covers the settings page background.
  • Dismissals now follow the announcement, so a new message shows again.
  • Fixed countdown timer that kept running after it ended.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added top and bottom notification bars.
  • Added call-to-action buttons and links.
  • Added sticky bar and countdown timer.
  • Added start and end date scheduling.
  • Added page-specific display and user role visibility.
  • Added dismiss, reopen, and auto-close options.
  • Added scroll triggers and entrance animations.
  • Added mobile visibility control.
  • Added ready-made themes and design customization.
  • Added custom CSS ID and class support.
  • Added settings import and export.
  • Added [mytop_bar] shortcode and Notification Bar block.
